# `scikitplot.mlflow`

<!-- Generated by `python tools/maint_tools/generate_usage_skills.py sync` from the installed package; edit the module's docstrings or `__all__`, not this file. -->

``MLflow UI | SERVER`` share the exact same settings.

## Install

```sh
pip install scikit-plots
pip install scikit-plots-mlflow  # this part only
```

## Before writing code

The API below was read from one version of the package. Check the version the
project has, and read a name's docstring and signature before calling it:

```sh
python -c "import scikitplot; print(scikitplot.__version__)"
python -c "import scikitplot.mlflow as m, inspect; print(inspect.signature(m.<name>)); help(m.<name>)"
```

## Example (from the docstring of `scikitplot.mlflow`)

```pycon
Quiskstart Template: Beginner workflow demo

>>> import os
>>> import scikitplot as sp
>>>
>>> # print(sp.mlflow.DEFAULT_PROJECT_MARKERS)
>>> # Walk upward from `start` until a directory containing any marker is found.
>>> # export SCIKITPLOT_PROJECT_MARKERS='[".git","pyproject.toml","README.txt","configs/mlflow.toml"]'
>>> os.environ["SCIKITPLOT_PROJECT_MARKERS"] = (
...     '[".git","pyproject.toml","README.txt","configs/mlflow.toml"]'
... )
>>> sp.mlflow.workflow(
...     profile="local",
...     open_ui_seconds=30,
...     experiment_name="my-first-project",
...     fmt="toml",
...     overwrite=True,  # If config already exists: ./configs/mlflow.toml (use overwrite=True).
... )

CLI

>>> # Walk upward from `start` until a directory containing any marker is found.
>>> # export SCIKITPLOT_PROJECT_MARKERS='[".git","pyproject.toml","README.txt","configs/mlflow.toml"]'
>>> python -m scikitplot.mlflow --profile local --open-ui-seconds 5
```
